title: Research and Pilot Trials to Promote and Expand Use of Productivity-enhancing Technologies by Care Providers
what_it_is: Research and Pilot Trials to Promote and Expand Use of Productivity-enhancing Technologies by Care Providers

sections.label: Population health research funding
sections.summary: Several programmes fund projects on population health, community care digitalisation and active ageing, each measured for impact and possible scaling up.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Under the Research, Innovation and Enterprise 2025 programme, the $90 million Population Health Research Grant supports projects that seek to improve health outcomes through a population health approach, including projects that aim to optimise resource allocation, improve healthcare manpower productivity and leverage technology to improve health.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The $18 million Community Care Digital Transformation Plan supports Community Care Organisations to adopt a comprehensive suite of digital solutions that help to raise digitalisation levels and improve productivity.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In addition, the National Innovation Challenge on Active and Confident Ageing had awarded close to $70 million to 35 research projects to address the needs of seniors or improve productivity of care staff.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: One example is a web-based system integrating technology to enhance care at home, including the use of smart home sensors to detect falls, automated pill dispensers to track medication adherence and a nutrition database that recommends meals based on the senior's health condition.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Another used artificial intelligence to provide personalised educational resources and care triage services to caregivers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Each project is measured for their impact, with a view to scale them up if proven to be effective.

sections.label: Overlap across care projects
sections.summary: The Minister notes overlap between projects across acute, elderly, hospital, community, productivity and digitalisation efforts, so overall effect should be reviewed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: There is great overlap in many of the projects: something that applies to acute care may well have an impact on elderly care; something that applies within the hospital may have an impact on the community; something which is labelled as a productivity improvement may indeed rest on digitalisation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, I think we do need to look at the overall effect of our various efforts to improve care, improve productivity, improve the effectiveness of our interventions and, where appropriate, use technology.
